notes.title: The Final Chapter: Face the Ultimate Challenge
notes.content:
Brave Usurper,

The final chapter of 'Usurper Soulbound' has arrived, bringing the Usurper’s story to its conclusion. Face the ultimate challenge, uncover the final secrets, and complete your journey.

[h2][b]Major Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ending Sequence and Final Boss:[/b]
The story is now complete. Face the final boss and finish the journey you’ve been on. The last pieces of the magical crystal are waiting, and with them comes the final chapter of your adventure.
[*] [b]New Dungeon Variations:[/b]
I’ve added more level variations to the Forest and Iceland Realms, so every run will feel a little different. New layouts mean new challenges, so stay sharp!
[/list]
[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Teleport Runes:[/b]
Less backtracking! Teleport Runes placed in various locations in dungeons will let you move quickly between areas you’ve already explored. 
[*] [b]Performance Fixes in Ice Lands:[/b]
The Ice Land dungeon now runs smoother with better performance by reducing unnecessary shadows that were produced by the foliage in the level. This should make exploring and fighting in the area much better.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
When opening minimap while running, marked locations would be shifted. The minimap shifting issue has been fixed.
A bunch of other small bugs have been cleaned up to improve your experience.
[/list]
[h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]
With this update, most of the big features are now in the game, and we’re finally at the last stretch. The final showdown and conclusion to your journey are here.

As always, I can’t thank you enough for playing, giving feedback, and supporting the game. Whether you’ve been here from the start or joined recently, you’ve helped shape "Usurper Soulbound" into what it is today.

This update gets us one step closer to the finish line, and I’m excited to hear your thoughts. 

Game on,
Sohrab 
Usurper Lead Developer

notes.title: Forest And Ice Realm Endings
notes.content:
Brave Usurpers,

As we’re getting closer to the end of our epic "Usurper Soulbound" adventure together, here comes our next patch including some major updates and improvments: 

[h2][b]Major Updates[/b][/h2] 
[list] 
[*] [b]Forest and Ice Fortress world Endings:[/b] The Usurper story expands with new endings for both the Frost Realm and the Ice Fortress Realm. Following the improvements and the ending to the Crypt World in our last update, the final boss fights as well as story cutscenes for both remaining realms have been added. Defeat them to grab the final pieces of the magical crystal which is the key to unlocking the mystery of the purgatory you are trapped in.
[/list]
[h2][b] Other Improvements[/b][/h2] 
[list] 
[*] [b]Soul Binding Ability:[/b] The choice is now yours. Bind your soul to a usurper shrine and continue your exploration without returning to the HUB world. This will allow you to continue to explore the dungeons uninterrupted. This choice, however, comes with a price – your gold and a portion of your soul, so choose wisely.
[*] [b]Dungeon Map Update:[/b] With the soul binding ability allowing for longer stretches of exploration, navigating the dungeon has now become more intuitive. As you explore, areas you've discovered will lighten, while unexplored regions remain shadowed. This visual contrast allows you to identify where you've been and where mysteries still await.
[*] [b]Co-op Revivals:[/b] Previously only the main player could revive the second player. This has been changed to that the co-op mode now allows both players to revive each other, adding to the bond between comrades.
[*] [b]Homeward Spell:[/b] Facing overwhelming odds? The new Homeward spell offers a strategic retreat, allowing players to get out of perilous situations and return to safety. 
[*] [b]Usurping Visual Cue:[/b] Enhancing the usability of the usurper mechanic, the Dagger now emits a distinctive particle effect when fully charged and ready for possession. This visual indicator works alongside the usurper bar to offer a clear, intuitive signal for when you can take control of new bodies, making usurping more iintuitive and adding the tactical depth of encounters.
[/list]
[h2][b] Approching the final chapter[/b][/h2] 
As we near the final chapter, with almost all planned features (and then some) released, only the ultimate showdown with the final boss and the game's concluding act remain. 

Reflecting on this journey through Early Access, my gratitude is boundless for the small but incredible group of supporters who have recommanded the game on Steam and consistently liked our updates and posts. Your support has been the fuel for the countless hours and effort poured into "Usurper Soulbound," propelling it to become a game that's surpassed even my own expections.

Be sure though that this is not the end. As we prepare to bring "Usurper Soulbound" out of the shadows and into the light, equipped with everything learned during the development of Usurper, we are already dreaming up new worlds to explore. Your support has certainly a big role in paving the way for our future endeavors, and I can't wait to share the next adventure with you.

Until then, enojy this new update and continue to be the incredible community you've always been. 

Game on, and catch you all later :)

notes.title: Story Enhancement Update
notes.content:
Hello brave Usurpers,

First off a heartfelt thank you to all who have been keeping up with these patch notes and showing your support. It truly means a lot.

Up until now, the focus has been on beefing up content and making sure gameplay feels smooth. But with all three planned biomes alive in-game, it is the right time to delve deep into the story, where this whole adventure began. And that is what this update is all about:

[h2][b]Story Enhancements[/b][/h2] 
[list]
[*] [b][u]Revamped Backstory[/u]:[/b] While the essence of the story has been there from the start, I’ve recently put significant energy into refining and rewriting the entire script. I wanted to ensure the narrative truly resonates, with each dialogue and cutscene crafted to draw you deeper into the world of Usurper:Soulbound.
[*] [b][u]Voiced and Revamped Dialogues[/u]:[/b] All in game dialogue is now voiced. I've also taken some time to revamp much of the dialogue to align it more closely with the refined storyline. With this patch, you'll find that interactions and discussions will feel more cohesive and will drop subtle hints, giving you a deeper understanding of the mystery at hand. 
[*] [b][u]Creep World Ending[/u]:[/b] The Crypt World now comes to a close with an ending cutscene. Here, the player will be awarded a vision, a glimpse into their past, unveiling a piece of the puzzle on why they're ensnared in this purgatorial journey. 
[*] [b][u]New Memory Cutscenes[/u]:[/b] As the story progresses and the player collects Crystal shards at the end of each realm, they're rewarded with memories of their past life. Look out for these new scenes to unravel more of the mystery.
[/list]
[h2][b] Other Improvements[/b][/h2] 
[list] 
[*] [b]Guidance to the Crypt World:[/b] Enhanced guidance after entering the HUB world for the first time to make it easier to locate the Crypt World portal.
[*] [b]Revamped Tutorials:[/b] Refined tutorials to ensure players can grasp game mechanics better. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Usurper Shrine Vulnerability:[/b] Addressed an issue where players could get hit during the usurper shrine activation. Invulnerability is now ensured during this action. [/list]

notes.title: Revamped Combat and Magic
notes.content:
Hello brave Usurpers,

Here comes a new update which includes enhancements, tweaks, and bug fixes all designed to refine the player's experience. A key highlight of this update is a major improvement in the combat system's responsiveness, thanks to a revamped input buffer. On top of that, the magic system has been made more combat-friendly and an easier method for selecting magic scrolls has been added in.

Without further ado, here are the specifics:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Responsive Combat System:[/b] We've improved the games input buffer to give you more precision and responsiveness in combat. Feel the difference with every button press!
[*] [b]Quicker Magic Casting:[/b] Your spells will now cast faster, making them easier to use, even in the heat of battle.
[*] [b]Effortless Scroll Selection:[/b] We've made selecting magic scrolls a lot more convenient. Say goodbye to arrow keys and hello to mouse selection!
[*] [b]More Dialogue:[/b] We've added more dialogue to the cultists and the vendor, making your interactions more immersive.
[*] [b]Easier Prologue/Tutorial:[/b] Based on your feedback, we've tuned down the difficulty of the prologue, making it a smoother start for new players.
[*] [b]Useful Hints:[/b] To keep you engaged during load times, we've added more useful hints on the loading screen.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Camera Switch Issue:[/b] Fixed a bug where the camera would not switch correctly when players exited a scene with the Usurper Dagger.
[/list]

notes.title: New Level Available Now! Take on the Ice Fortress
notes.content:
I am back with a Major Update. This update includes a [b]New Playable Area (The Ice Fortress)[/b] with five new bodies to usurp and a couple of new weapons. You need to be level 16 or more to be able to enter this area.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LWFM5g1.gif[/img]

Here is a list of some other changes:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Scrolls :[/b] Healing and invisibility scrolls.
[*] [b]Dynamic difficulty adjustments :[/b] Difficulty has been reduced in the starting portions of the game. But if the player performs better than expected difficulty is increased to match their skill level.
[*] [b]Scroll use only when enemies are nearby:[/b] Certain scrolls (like freeze or lightning) can be only used when enemies are around. I did this to prevent players from wasting their scroll by pressing the cast button by mistake when no enemy is around.
 [/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - After getting Usurper dagger in the beginning, the player's hit box would expand.
[*] Fixed - Players would be transported below the level where enemies are gathered in a pool.
[/list]

notes.title: New Forest Level
notes.content:
Happy new year you all ːsteamhappyː 

Here comes the next update which adds a new forest floor with four additional usurp shrines as well as two new body types to play as. One is a shaman with lightning magic and the other one is a war chief with a big ass skull mace.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/FalseSlimArgusfish-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Here is a list of other changes listed below:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lower level barrier to enter forest :[/b] Now players can enter the forest at level 6.
[*] [b]Faster dodge back attacks :[/b] Players can attack out of the dodge back animations within a shorter amount  of time.
[*] [b]Inventory full message:[/b] When inventory is full a pop up text is shown on the weapon to notify the player.
[*] [b]More enemy drops:[/b] Higher chance of enemies dropping more Usurper might and healing pick ups.
 [/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Spear orc could not pick up a shield. Now she can.
[*] Fixed - Player would go into crossbow holding animation without the crossbow in hand.
[*] Fixed - Player would change weapon when scrolling through vendor shop.
[/list]

notes.title: New Level Available Now! Take on the Forest
notes.content:
It has been a little while seen the last update but we are back with a [b]Major Update[/b]. The update includes a [b]New Playable Area (The Forest)[/b] with [b]New Bodies to Usurp[/b], as well as several other improvements and bug fixes. 

Here comes a list of all changes since the last update:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Level:[/b] Now you have access to The Forest with enemies/bodies to posses and several new weapons to use, and most importantly, new stuff to break ːsteamhappyː The area is accessed through the HUB. But you will need to be level 8 or above to be able to enter.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/CreativeHappygoluckyIrishdraughthorse-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/MiserlyFarflungCoelacanth-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Usurp Menu Redesign:[/b] Usurp menu is redesigned to look easier on the eyes as well as easier to navigate. Each body is seen in full and the weapons each body hold are seen as well to help decide which one to choose.

[*] [b]Faster attack animation rates :[/b] Attack animations are adjusted to create a smoother combat experience.

[*] [b] Vendor Menu Navigation:[/b] Auto scrolling is removed when using keyboard and mouse so you can use mouse wheel to scroll the menu without interference. Auto scrolling speed reduced to a comfortable speed for controller.

[*] [b] Stat-Screen Update:[/b] Player stat-screen in Usurp Menu is less cluttered now as some of the less useful information is removed. 

[*] [b]Skill points left in level:[/b] As more than one portal is accessible in the HUB, the number of skill points in each level is shown to help players decide which level they want to travel to next.

[*] [b]Stamina Not Used Outside Combat:[/b] This allows players to sprint when not in combat so they can navigate the dungeons faster when not fighting.
 [/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Ranged enemies would not be staggered by lightning. Now they do, unless they have a magical shield.

[*] Fixed - On usurping a new body, all weapons would carry over from previous body regardless of the new bodies weight carry limit. Now the weapons over the limit are dropped on the floor.

[*] Fixed - Changing weapons with controller would happen very fast and result in jittery animation. Now the speed is limited to create a more smooth experience.

[*] Fixed - Dash animations were the same for all weapons. Now weapons have their own dash animation.

[*] Fixed - Sprint animations for Mage and Knight were not correct. Now they are fixed to look as they should.

[*] Fixed - Sometimes death animation was not played on enemy death.

 [/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.4.3.4
notes.content:
Here comes a list of changes since the last update including sprinting and sprint attacks, rolling and more responsive player inputs. See below for more info:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Sprinting and sprint attacks:[/b] Now players can sprint which allows for faster navigation of dungeons. Also there a sweet sprint attack which should be fun to play around with. Player movement speed in general is also increased to increase the pace of combat.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/FarawayDecentGrison-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[*] [b] Rolling:[/b] Dodge rolling is added but most important is that now you can break stuff while rolling around which I find personally very satisfying ːsteamhappyː

[*] [b]Floor two boss reduced difficulty:[/b] The newly added second floor boss would do a long chain of combos which would make him difficult to fight. The number of attacks is adjusted now.

[*] [b]More responsive inputs:[/b] Input while player was staggered was not registered which would make the game less responsive. Now player input during stagger is registered in a buffer would should increase input responsiveness. Also player has a larger window of time to rotate before being lock in attack animations.
 [/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Inventory would sometimes not open.

[*] Fixed - Sometimes player could target enemies through walls.

[*] Fixed - Mage enemy would not attack after getting struck by lightning spell. This bug is now fixed. Also if they have a shield the damage is absorbed by shield first before damaging mage.

[*] Fixed - Pressing start new game would jump over the prologue at random.

[*] Fixed - Usurp might was not filled in the beginning of the game.

[*] Fixed - Bug with long sword wielding enemies when hit by lightning spell where hands would remain attached during stun animation. Now the hands are separated during stun animation and attached again after.

 [/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.4.2.3
notes.content:
Here comes a list of changes since the last update including a new special shield, guard counters and various bug fixes. See below for more info:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New special equipment:[/b] yet another special equipment that can be found in the dungeons. So far all special equipments have been weapons but this one is a shield.

[*] [b] Guard counter:[/b] Speaking of shields, you can do a guard counter with you shield now (you can probably tell which game I have been playing a lot of lately ːsteamhappyː). When blocking, you can now do a powerful counter by attacking right after a hit is blocked. 

[*] [b]Attack animation improvements:[/b] A couple of different weapons attack animations have been tweaked to make them faster and feel more impactful.

[*] [b]Change weapons button:[/b] Change weapon button on game-pad was mapped to D-Pad down before which would make it difficult to switch weapons mid combat. Now it is mapped to right sick down which should make this much easier.
 [/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - When shield would absorb damage and lose durability, in the button left corner of the screen , this would be reflected on the equipped weapon. Now the equipped shield icon is shown. 

[*] Fixed - Player would rotate sometimes rotate to a random direction after lock off from a target.

[*] Fixed -  Player could do parry counter without parrying an actual attack. Now you have to parry the attack to do the parry counter.

[*] Fixed - Player would rotate upwards sometimes when they used the Mighty Sword special ability.

[*] Fixed - Damage feedback would not show when enemy was not staggered by an attack. Now it does regardless of enemy stagger state.

[*] Fixed - Tutorials would be shown repeatedly in the prologue area. Now they are shown only once.
 [/list]

notes.title: Easter Update (patch 5.4.1.0)
notes.content:
Here comes the next patch which includes a bunch of new features such as a new Dungeon Mini Boss and a special Easter Egg to prepare for the upcoming holidays. See below for more info :)

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Dungeon Mini Boss:[/b] An even bigger dude to replace the previous big dude as the second floor mini boss.

[img] https://thumbs.gfycat.com/BoringTornBagworm-size_restricted.gif [/img]

[*] [b]New Easter Egg:[/b] As the Easter holidays are almost here, a new Easter Egg room with a unique weapon has been added in the dungeons. I think many of players would recognize and enjoy this one but I don't want to spoil it more (hint: look at the update image carefully).

[*] [b] Secret Reveal Scroll :[/b] And to help players find the Easter Eggs and other secret, Mini Bosses now have a chance of dropping a scroll on death which reveals the location of a secret in the dungeon.

[*] [b]New Poise System:[/b] Aside from regular damage, players now take poise damage from enemy attacks which affects them differently based on how much poise they have. Poise can be increased by possessing bodies with higher poise or using magic.

[*] [b] Kick poise damage adjustment:[/b] Previously kick would throw back all enemies except mini bosses. Now based on player poise and enemy resistance stats they might be just staggered and not thrown.

[*] [b]Poise Buff Spell:[/b] New magic scroll that temporarily increase player poise damage on for all attacks.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Weapon sometimes would take twice or more damage on a single hit which would make them break quickly. Now weapons take damage only once time per hit.

[*] Fixed - Boss doors in floor 2 would not show their level requirements. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.9.1
notes.content:
Here comes a list of changes since the last update:

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Inventory:[/b] As the number of equipment that players can choose from is growing, you have now the ability to drop your items via an inventory interface. You can OPEN your inventory by pressing “I” on the keyboard or “Select” on the gamepad and DROP items by pressing “K” on the keyboard or “Face Button Right” on the gamepad.

[*] [b]Lightning spell:[/b] Strike multiple enemies by lightning. The affected enemy is stunned and takes continuous damage but also does lightning damage to anything that is close to it. Can be found in one of the special rooms in the dungeons.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/WellinformedAlienatedHorsefly-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Abyss Greatsword:[/b] A unique greatsword which allows you to teleport short distances. Can be found in one of the special rooms in the dungeons.

[*] [b]Friendly Fire:[/b] Friendly fire in co-op is now turned off by default. It needs to be turned on manually via the options menu.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed - issue when sometimes enemies would stop attacking player once losing sight temporarily of the player.
[*] Fixed - issue when enemy would remain standing in level after dying.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.8.9
notes.content:
Here comes the first update of 2022. As you might have noticed Santa had stayed in the HUB world a bit longer than he should have. The truth is he wanted to leave earlier but I was unfortunately pretty sick and could not send him on his way. But I am back on my feet and have sent Santa on his way. 

Even though Santa is gone, the candy cane weapon that was introduced in the previous patch is still available. Players that got the weapon from Santa get to keep it. And for new players it can be found in one of the Easter Egg Rooms in the dungeons.

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Gestures:[/b] Players can now use gestures which is especially fun when fighting a friend. You can trigger them by pressing the “x” on the keyboard or “select” button on the controller. At the moment there are only two but more will be added in future updates.
[*] [b]Special weapons:[/b] These are unique weapons that can be found in special rooms in the dungeons that require some exploration to find. So far there is one such weapon which is Santa's Candy cane but more weapons will be added in the coming updates.
[*] [b]Equipment carry over:[/b] This is something that was added in a previous patch that was not announced so it will be mentioned here. Previously you would lose your weapon on usurping  a new body but now they carry over.
[*] [b]Summoned player attributes:[/b] Previously the second player would get full health and usurp might on summon. But now it will get the same amount as the main player to balance the game.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Double shields: [/b]Fixed issue with player having a shield stuck in their head when usurping a body with a shield when they already had a shield
[/list]

notes.title: Christman Update
notes.content:
Surprise! Look who has come by for a visit. And he has a some special gifts for you too. So go find him and see what he has in store for you ːsteamhappyː 

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DishonestBlindHoverfly-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Other than Santa coming to town with his gifts there is actually not much else new in this update, other than a bug fix (see below), but I think it still deserves to be a major update as it is the last update from us in 2021. Wish you all great holidays. 

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed - If mage enemy attacked while in slow motion, his projectile would remain in slow motion even afterwards. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.8.1 (Co-op Improvments)
notes.content:
Here comes a new update with a bunch of improvements and bug fixes but most importantly:
[list]
[*] The ability to Usurp for the second player
[*] And fixing a bug with the mighty kick which makes kicking enemies into traps a much more viable strategy in combat (see details in patch notes).
[/list]
Also as we are getting closer to that special time of the year, we are working on a special holiday update with some surprises in store, but more on that later ːsteamhappyː

[b]Co op improvements and bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Second player can usurp enemies
[*] Fixed - Bug where second player would not get GP on killing enemies
[*] Fixed - Bug where freeze spell would not work in co op mode.
[*] Bigger player icons with different colors to so players can easier identify themselves on the map in co op mode
[*] Fixed - Bug where enemies would slow down on usurping but second player would not. Now there is no slow down when usurping in co op mode.
[*] Fixed - Bug where background elements would occasionally disappear in co op mode.
[*] Fixed - Bug where split screen would remain active after returning from game to main menu
[*] Fixed - Bug where second player would come back to HUB without losing their body
[/list]

[b]Other Improvements and bug fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Bug where enemy was not thrown in the direction of players kick. Now their throw in the same direction which makes kicking enemies into traps a much more viable strategy in combat
[*] Fixed - Text for Luck in the skill upgrade menu was out of bound. 
[*] Higher poise damage for Axe. Axe heavy attacks can stagger big enemies now.
[*] Chance of chest explosions are reduced and replaced by GP drops.
[*] Main and pause menu button improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.7.8 (Faster load times and more)
notes.content:
Here comes the next patch with improvements and bug fixes that addresses a bunch of things pointed out in the feedback we received from you so far. Most important is a significant reduction in load times which makes starting a new run after dying quicker (shout out to the player who pointed this out, you know who you areːsteamhappyː).

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Significant reduction in load screen time,
[*] More GP gain in co-op play when an enemy is killed,
[*] Icon animation in dungeon map to guide player to next Shrine,
[*] Luck skill double damage chance nerfed as it was too powerful
[/list]

[b]Combat Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly slower enemy reaction time so players have more time to defend before an enemy starts attacking,
[*] Reduced enemy chase speed when players are fighting without locking on
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Enemies sometimes not attacking the player and just circling around,
[*] Fixed - Player was able to move around during arrival in HUB cut scene
[*] Fixed - Icons sometimes not showing on dungeon map

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.7.2
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding a new mini boss enemy type that protects Usurper shrines in the first floor, 
[*] Adding a magic resistance attribute to enemies so some enemies are affected less by player magic attacks and scrolls than others,
[*] Adjustments to the prices of some bodies and scrolls,
[*] Reduced spell casting animation time
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.6.2 (Combat improvments and more)
notes.content:
Here comes the next update. Since there are some major changes done, feel free to comment here if you have any feedback on the changes or find something you want to report.

[b] Major Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Combat improvements:[/b]
        - Easier targeting of enemies nearby 
        - Players can now directly target agro enemies (mouse wheel up/controller left stick up)
        - Dynamic-adjustment of the number of enemies per each encounter 
        - Improved auto-aiming while playing unlocked
[*] [b]The "frustrating" all GP lost on shrine activation is no more:[/b]
        - So now you get to keep all your GP on shrine activation and go back to HUB to spend all that sweet gold you have gathered. Instead you will lose the remaining GP you have not spent when entering you next run.
[*] [b]Easter eggs (work in progress):[/b]
       - We are working on adding Easter egg artifacts into the dungeon, paying homage to the games that we love and have been influenced by. This is still a work in progress but you can find some signs of things happening if you search the dungeons carefully.
[*]  [b]Engine update:[/b]
      - We have moved Usurper: Soulbound to a newer version of Unreal Engine. This affects mostly behind the scenes stuff rather than gameplay but should improve performance on lower end machines, if not blame Epic Games (joking, all praise be to epic games) ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

[b] Minor Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Increasing stay time for enemy drops so it takes longer for them to vanish
[*] Explanation for red dots added to dungeon map guide
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.4.3.7 (Usurping and co-op improvments)
notes.content:
Going through the feedback and reviews that we have got so far to improve the game based on your feedback. Here are two that we have addressed in this patch:

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Usurping mini-game - We got some feedback regarding the mini-game being frustrating especially when the bar was moving too fast. So now you will be able to Usurp enemies regardless of if you get the timing right however if you get the timing right you will get a bonus GP. So you are rewarded for doing a tougher challenge rather than being punished for missing it.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed - summoned player would be at skill level 0. Now they get the same skills as the main player.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5.3.4.6 (New Game Plus)
notes.content:
New Game Plus is here!

After finishing the early access content players unlock and can continue playing the game in New Game Plus mode. 

There are also some other minor improvements such as changing the animations for magic dagger while using a shield to faster ones and changing some enemy placements in the dungeon second floor.

notes.title: Patch 5.3.4.4 (bug fixes)
notes.content:
Here goes our first patch, fixing some bugs found during the live stream session yesterday:
